name: Undertow
tagline: Pull treasure from the deep until the tide turns on you.
core_loop: Draw cards one at a time into your face-up Haul, or salvage from the Wreck; matching the shared Undertow rank or a rank you already hold wipes your Haul; bank to make points safe and claim the Undertow.
win_condition: Most points in Hold plus Haul when the deck runs out.
